programmes.about: UTM's full-time civil engineering honours degree on the Skudai campus, accredited by the Engineering Accreditation Council of the Board of Engineers Malaysia.
programmes.overview: The faculty page states EAC accreditation and a full-time programme on the UTM Skudai main campus. Study lasts four to a maximum of six years depending on entry qualification. The international list shows September and February intakes, and this is the only faculty programme open to international applicants for February 2027.

programmes.about: A four-year Malaysia-Japan International Institute of Technology degree in electronic systems, from power electronics and IC design to AI and IoT applications.

summary: Malaysian public technical university with campuses in Johor Bahru and Kuala Lumpur; 44 degrees on the international list, four open for February 2027.

ib.text: IB Diploma accepted. Engineering degrees need 4 in Maths, Physics and Chemistry or Biology (5 for electrical); no total points published. Course Results alone are not addressed. IB exempts English.

languageOfInstruction.note: International undergraduates need IELTS 5.5 or equivalent unless exempt, which implies English-medium study. The reviewed pages do not state the teaching language of each degree; confirm before applying.

notes: February 2027 is the only intake with published dates (applications 1 November to 31 December 2026). A September 2027 deadline and the status of the other degrees marked 'Closed' are not published; this record makes no promise about them.
February 2027 intake: international applicants may apply to Civil Engineering (Johor Bahru) and three MJIIT degrees (Kuala Lumpur). Other degrees on the list show September only and 'Closed'.

Teaching language: the reviewed pages do not state it for each degree. A 2018-19 MJIIT handbook listed Bahasa Malaysia and English for one degree, so confirm English-medium delivery with UTM before relying on this record.

IB entry is by subject score: engineering needs 4 or above in Mathematics and Physics plus Chemistry or Biology, and electrical engineering needs 5. No total-point minimum or subject level is published.
English: IELTS 5.5, TOEFL iBT 46, PTE Academic 51 or Cambridge 160 for most degrees. Candidates from international schools, A-level and IB are exempt from the English requirement.

Fees: engineering tuition shown for international students is RM 75,000 in total (RM 14,758 for semester 1 and RM 60,242 for semesters 2 to 8), excluding accommodation, with a registration fee of RM 6,152 per normal semester. No fee year is stated.
Civil Engineering takes four years minimum and up to six depending on entry qualification; MJIIT lists four years. A mandatory personal bond is set by Malaysian Immigration.
